cat tsconfig.json
grep x eslint.config.mjs
echo x > src/a.ts
cat tsconfig.json > /tmp/x
npx tsc -p tsconfig.json 2>&1 | tail
npx tsc -p tsconfig.json > /dev/null
npx tsc -p tsconfig.json > $null
npx eslint -c eslint.config.mjs src >&2
cp tsconfig.json /tmp/backup.json
Copy-Item tsconfig.json -Destination /tmp/x
git diff tsconfig.json | tee /tmp/diff
sed -n 1p tsconfig.json
rm -rf dist && cat tsconfig.json
git checkout main
git restore src/a.ts
cp tsconfig.json /tmp/tsconfig.json
echo x > /opt/other/.husky/pre-commit
rm ../other/tsconfig.json
